_about: Hand-labelled user reports from labelled.json, rewritten as if filed with the bug report form in .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml. Each answer only restates the original issue; the area guess is what the reporter would plausibly pick, not the label. evaluate.mjs renders these the way GitHub does and sends them instead of the original body.

632.What happened?: Supports block access to the model behind them in every mode where the mouse has to reach the model, even when they aren't visible. Placing new supports inside a hollowed model, or near the top where existing supports enclose the view, doesn't work. Hollowing holes can only be placed with a clear view through all the supports, even in the hollowing view that hides them. Zooming or hiding sections with the slider doesn't help.

627.What happened?: In the advanced resin preset for the Photon Mono 4, the speed menu suggests the plate lifts at 120 then 240 mm/min, then retracts at 360 and slows to 100 mm/min. In reality the retract speeds are tied to the wrong regions: the slow retraction happens first (at the top) and the fast one second (at the bottom). Same for normal and burn-in/transition layers. The speeds should match what the menu shows.
627.Steps to reproduce:
1. Open the advanced resin preset for the Photon Mono 4
2. Set two-stage retract speeds
3. Print and watch the retraction
